title: Page: from 20 s, about 10% of requests fail and p99 goes up a little.
explain: The third of the 4 API servers (#2) is 60 times slower; the others are fine. The load balancer sends in turn, so a quarter of the requests go to the slow one. A hedged request sends a read to another instance after 40 ms, but it does not cancel the first copy on the slow instance, so its queue fills quickly. When the queue is full, a request sent there is rejected at once: faster than the 40 ms of the hedge, so the hedge cannot save it. Writes are not hedged, so they are not saved either. Open the API server's metrics: one instance is full and the others are idle.
hint: Change the load balancer's policy to least connections: the slow instance has more open connections, so it gets fewer requests.
